name: You Rule My Body And Soul
original_name: You Rule My Body And Soul
overview: Carl, the eldest heir of a wealthy conglomerate family, is a domineering and obsessive man who always keeps a mysterious black cat by his side. At the family estate, he encounters Simon, a kind-hearted and soft-natured young gardener. Despite frequent clashes due to their stark differences in personality and social status, they gradually develop feelings for each other through mutual testing and understanding.
